Q8301.reason: Acts jure gestionis are State acts of a private or commercial nature, as opposed to sovereign acts (jure imperii).

Q8305.reason: Recognition of foreign judgments is generally based on comity and judicial discretion rather than treaty incorporation doctrines.

Q8317.reason: A brown irregular mass behind an intact tympanic membrane after chronic otitis media suggests cholesteatoma, which is proliferating epithelial (keratinizing squamous) tissue.
